ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud in the US
ideas.description: Investigate the scope and scale of child care fraud in the US, including the entities and programs involved, and the impact on taxpayers and vulnerable populations.
questions: What is the scope and scale of child care fraud in the US?
Which entities and programs are involved?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a widespread and complex issue, and to hold accountable those responsible for perpetuating fraud. I recommend starting with a thorough review of existing investigations and reports, and then conducting interviews with key stakeholders and experts.
